why_best: Plunging straight into the focal subject creates an unbroken spatial logic that keeps the creator engaged without jarring context switches.
why_bad: A standard lateral wipe or cross-dissolve flattens the depth, breaking the illusion that the creator is diving into the asset itself.
trap: A near-miss will overshoot the focal alignment mid-dive, causing the viewport to drift off-center before the target content fully takes over.
